title: Topic review and supervisor contact grants
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: src/app/actions/review-topic.ts: openTopic (submitted->under_review) and decideTopic (approve | reject | request_revision). review notes required for reject and revision. Approve runs in a transaction: team must have no approved_topic_id; set topic approved, team.approved_topic_id and team.status topic_approved; notify the team (topic_status); writeAudit topic.approved or topic.revision_requested.
Authorisation: the team's assigned supervisor if one exists, otherwise any supervisor whose staff_whitelist.programmes include the team's course_id; coordinators and admins may review.

src/lib/contacts/grants.ts: ensureContactGrants(txOrDb, teamId) creates supervisor_contacts/{supervisorId}/grants/{memberUid} for every member ONLY when assigned_supervisor_id is set, supervisor_assignment.status is 'accepted' and approved_topic_id is set (tolerate the assignment field not existing yet); revokeContactGrants(teamId). Called after approval here and after acceptance in 06-02. Unit/server tests.

/proposals supervisor view: queue table (team, group number, programme, rank, status, submitted date) with status and course filters, detail sheet (all fields, version history, duplicate scores), decision form.
assumptions: Other topics of the team are left unchanged when one is approved; a second approval is rejected
acceptance: A student cannot approve; a supervisor of another programme cannot review
Grants helper does nothing until the assignment is accepted
